recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 可見兩顆大型多核／多葉的巨細胞，核膜清楚、染色質空泡狀並有嗜酸性核仁，形似 Reed-Sternberg 細胞，周圍是小淋巴球、漿細胞、組織球、嗜中性球與內皮細胞混合的發炎背景。
features: Large giant cells with multilobated or overlapping nuclei, vesicular chromatin and distinct eosinophilic nucleoli (Reed-Sternberg-like)
Abundant amphophilic cytoplasm around the giant cells
Scattered intermediate-sized immunoblasts with single nucleoli
Mixed background of small lymphocytes, plasma cells, histiocytes and neutrophils
Activated endothelial cells, extravasated red cells and vacuolated, edematous stroma
describe_en: High-power examination shows scattered large atypical cells with multilobated nuclei, vesicular chromatin, prominent eosinophilic nucleoli and abundant amphophilic cytoplasm, closely resembling Reed-Sternberg cells. These are accompanied by occasional immunoblasts within a polymorphous infiltrate of small lymphocytes, plasma cells, histiocytes and neutrophils in an edematous, vascular stroma. Sheets of large cells are not seen. In the context of a mucocutaneous ulcer, the findings are suggestive of EBV-positive mucocutaneous ulcer, and immunophenotyping (CD30, CD15, CD20, PAX5) with EBER ISH is required to distinguish it from classic Hodgkin lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Morphology can be identical; cHL HRS cells are CD15+, CD20-negative with weak PAX5 and involve lymph nodes, whereas EBVMCU is a sharply circumscribed ulcer with CD20+ often CD15-weak large cells.
Hallmark cells with kidney-shaped nuclei grow cohesively in sinuses or sheets and are CD30+ T/null cells lacking PAX5.
Enlarged cells show a single large intranuclear owl-eye inclusion with halo and granular cytoplasmic inclusions, often in endothelial cells, rather than multilobated nuclei with multiple nucleoli.
